title: Directive
description: The `directive` constant declared at the top of every Rego module. Carries the authoritative metadata for one USDA departmental directive.

label.description: Unique directive label. Example: DR0100-001, DM3505-005, DR3300-001-A.

title.description: Official directive title as extracted from the document header.

directive_type.description: Directive classification derived from the label prefix (DR/DM/SM/DN/DG).

effective_date.description: ISO-8601 date on which the directive became effective, or 'Unknown' when not parseable from the document header.

expiration_date.description: ISO-8601 date on which the directive expires. Present only when an explicit expiration date appears in the document header.

opi.description: Office of Primary Interest — the USDA office responsible for maintaining the directive.
examples: Office of the Chief Financial Officer

nist_families.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev5 control family codes inferred from directive content using keyword mapping.

source_url.description: Authoritative USDA directives portal URL from the harvest manifest.

NistFamily.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev5 control family two-letter abbreviation.
